name: visit-report
title: Store visit report
for_each: select id,code from store.audits order by code

sections.title: Checklist responses
sections.sql: select code,section,question,outcome,note from store.checks where audit_id=$1 order by section,code

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select x.code,x.title,x.owner,x.due_date,x.state from store.actions x join store.checks c on c.id=x.check_id where c.audit_id=$1 order by x.due_date

name: action-record
title: Corrective action record
for_each: select id,code from store.actions order by code

name: evidence-register
title: Store evidence review register
for_each: select id,code from store.sites order by code

sections.title: Store
sections.sql: select code,name,region,owner,country from store.sites where id=$1

sections.title: Evidence references
sections.sql: select e.code,e.reference,e.personal,e.purpose,e.access_owner,e.review_on from store.evidence e join store.checks c on c.id=e.check_id join store.audits a on a.id=c.audit_id where a.site_id=$1 order by e.review_on
sections.note: References only. Review the actual files and their access controls separately.
